title: An associated prime of a submodule is an associated prime of the module
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $M$ an $R$-module and $N\subseteq M$ an $R$-submodule. Call a prime ideal $\mathfrak p\subset R$ an *associated prime* of an $R$-module $P$ if there is $z\in P$ with $\operatorname{Ann}_R(z)=\{a\in R: az=0\}=\mathfrak p$, and write $\operatorname{Ass}_R(P)$ for the set of them. Then $\operatorname{Ass}_R(N)\subseteq\operatorname{Ass}_R(M)$.
